## ⛔ PLANNING RECONCILIATION — 2026-09-04

**⚠️ QA FAILED 2026-09-01 — moved back to Todo. This is a rework round.**

**The QA FAIL comment (Erin Bolas, verbatim):**

> FAIL — fix does not appear to be deployed. Re-tested accordion open timing on 3 of the pages in "Confirmed on" (`/vat-registration/`, `/company-dissolution/`, `/`) plus `/company-address-guide/`: clone still opens in **~465-470ms (46-47 frames)** on all 4, matching this ticket's original pre-fix numbers almost exactly. Live is consistently **~100-120ms** on the same pages. Moving back to Todo.

### What that tells you

- The gap is **~4×**, unchanged from the original report — this reads as "the change never reached the deployed build", the same failure signature as CORE-7108's round.
- SITEWIDE: the shared `CollapsibleList--collapsibleList__content` component (declared `grid-template-rows` 0.15s `cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1)`) is behind every FAQ-style accordion on the site, so a fix must be verified on **every named instance**, not one page.
- Note the arithmetic: a declared 0.15s transition cannot itself account for 465ms. Establish where the remaining time actually goes before changing a duration value.
acceptanceCriteria: Accordion open completes within live’s ~100-120ms envelope, measured by frame count, on all 4 pages named in the QA FAIL comment (`/vat-registration/`, `/company-dissolution/`, `/`, `/company-address-guide/`) plus at least one further page using the component.
Measured on the DEPLOYED clone and the report states explicitly where — the prior round failed on "does not appear to be deployed".
The report identifies what actually consumed the ~465ms, since the declared 0.15s transition alone cannot explain it.
Close/collapse timing, and single-open vs multi-open behaviour, do not regress on the pages tested.
